notes.title: The Second Era is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24319119/28e06241c38a674f04d5401aaefa477e178fe5a2.png[/img]
[b]Hi folks!
After no patching for a month, finally it is here.
I won't write all additions/removals here but here it is the importants.

First of all, data has been wiped for a new game and new balance.
[/b]

[h1]Additions/Removals[/h1]
[list]
[*] Guild system added.
[*] Crafting added with 6 crafting skills.
[*] New balance made from zero.
[*] New UI
[*] New NPC owning system. They won't retreat after you logout or server restart. Yours is yours.
[*] Shrink potion & polymorph scroll cannot be purchased from vendors anymore.
[*] Global Trading Market added
[*] Bone customization on character customization
[*] Added: Foods
[*] Added: Two weather conditions: Snow, rain
[*] New resource regeneration system
[*] Removed: Local server, it is not available anymore. Now, the game is playable only on online server.
Removed: World editor extension because playing on local is not available anymore.
[i]I know you will be angry for local server but it is not on my hand.[/i]
[*]Removed hardcore system
[/list]

With the new features, you will face a lot of new things in the game.
You will see the game is changed. It is not the game you have played in 2016 anymore. But it will bring us new bugs, so please report the bugs on here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/454070/discussions/0/135510194254996509/

Enjoy the new game.
Sincerely,
Eren

notes.title: Boundel: The Second Era
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24319119/728d5912b2d73123249cd56dd5399543f165feb7.png[/img]

Hola!
The Second Era, the game changer will be available at the end of the February.
It will be free of course as every update but If you do not have Boundel yet, got one before the new increased price.

[h1]Boundel: The Second Era[/h1]
[list]
[*]Crafting
Search resources around the world for ingots, woods, leathers, meats, empty bottles and blank scrolls to use them on crafting.

Skills
[list]
[*][b]Alchemy[/b] to make potions
[*][b]Blacksmithing[/b] to make armor & weapons & shields
[*][b]Cooking[/b] to cook foods make you stronger.
[*][b]Tailoring[/b] to make leather armors.
[*][b]Inscription[/b] to make scrolls and spellbooks.
[*][b]Woodworking[/b] to make & staves & bows & wooden shields
[/list]

[*]Everyitem is now unique with Legendariness Modifier. [i]If a short sword gives you 6 attack power, %100 Legendary Short Sword gives you 12![/i]
[*]Grab a shovel and search for treasures if you are not even a fighter.
[*]A new & nice user interface made from zero.
[/list]

With the new shaders & visuals, feel the next generation with Boundel: The Second Era.
Screenshots, gameplay videos and more details soon.

Best,
Eren

notes.content:

Level of the most leveled character in your account * 1000

[u]You will also get a unique item, it cannot be dropped from monsters.[/u]

notes.title: Patch 0.4c is available!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.boundel.com/images/steam/0.4c.jpg[/img]


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cloak item type added with cloth physics.
[*]Looting from players disabled. When a player dies, only gold coins in their inventory will be dropped. Gold coins on the bank box is safe.
[*]Last death position icon added.
[*]New loot and treasure algoritm. More accurate items, a lot of rares!
[*]New quality option: Ultra high
[*].stuck feature. Type '.stuck' on chat if you stucked at a position.
[*]New spell type: 'World' with two spells yet. Wall of Stone & Wall of Fire.
[*]Wall of Stone, creates walls to cover.
[*]Wall of Fire, a line of fire hits continuously.
[*]Newbie players will able to loot/drop every item.
[*]More balanced spells.
[*]x2 experience at night.
[/list]

Next patch will be available before July.
It will be a quite big patch.

Cheers,
Eren

notes.title: About the incoming patch & IMPORTANT NOTIFICATION ABOUT FULL LOOT PvP
notes.content:
[img]http://www.boundel.com/images/steam/04cAnnounce.jpg[/img]

Hi, I'm working on the new patch, the patch make the game well balanced & ofcourse some graphical improvements are coming.

[b]With the new patch, full loot pvp will be disabled permanently. It's nothing except pain for me and players.[/b]
Of course you will still able to fight with players, but only for gold coins.

[list]
[*]New item type: Cloaks, capes (With realistic cloth physics)
[*]A lot of bug fixes.
[*]Stuck feature, if you stucked somewhere you will able to use this option to get out. (.stuck)
[*]New spell type: 'World' with two spells yet. Wall of Stone & Wall of Fire.
[*]Newbie players will able to loot.
[*]More balanced spells.[/list]

I will update here some screens until the patch comes.

Cheers,
Eren
